full-name: The Rev. Gilbert Vivyan Heathcote

prefix: The Rev.
title: The Rev. Gilbert Vivyan Heathcote
dates: (12 July 1830-7 Feb 1890)
---

son of Sir William Heathcote’s first marriage

After going into the army and rather disappointing his father, he joined the church and became Rector of West Deeping, Lincolnshire.

He married three times, and CMY described him as ‘very hardworking & very High Church’.
